coverage: All ten anchored report paragraphs and their material component assertions are registered; findings retain parent claim IDs and assess each component in reasoning.

claims.report_quote: **PA-01.** C-101 satisfied the standard authorization path because its duty-manager approval preceded its start.

components.target: C-101 duty-manager approval is strictly before actual start.

claims.report_quote: **PA-02.** C-102 had a standard duty-manager approval before starting; its 10:00 request was that approval.

components.target: C-102 has a duty-manager standard approval before actual start.
The C-102 10:00 request constitutes that approval.

claims.report_quote: **PA-03.** C-102 satisfied the emergency authorization path, including a countersignature within 24 hours after start.

components.target: C-102 has an active qualifying incident and a pre-start duty-officer declaration.
Its countersignature is within the inclusive 24-hour interval.

claims.report_quote: **PA-04.** C-103 satisfied the standard authorization path because its approval was strictly before start.

components.target: C-103 approval is strictly before start.

claims.report_quote: **PA-05.** C-104 started without authorization under either path in P-17.

components.target: C-104 satisfies neither P02 nor P03.

claims.report_quote: **PA-06.** C-105 had no standard duty-manager approval before its proposed 2028-04-11 09:00 UTC start.

components.target: No C-105 standard approval preceded the proposed 2028-04-11 09:00 UTC start.

claims.report_quote: **PA-08.** C-102 was unauthorized solely because it lacked a standard approval.

components.target: Lack of standard approval alone establishes nonauthorization.
The C-102 emergency start was prudent.

claims.report_quote: **PA-10.** The supplied C-105 handoff package contains no external approval register.

components.target: The supplied C-105 package contains no external approval register.

excluded_questions.question: External law, source authenticity, and undocumented North Quay events
